method: Gilerson 2010 two-band; Sentinel-2 L2A BOA screening adaptation v1
input: Provider Sen2Cor L2A BOA reflectance, experimental approximation to aquatic reflectance
native_dn_conversion: asset scale/offset if provided; otherwise DN * 0.0001 plus -0.1 for baseline >= 04.00; older baselines offset 0
qc: positive finite reflectance in all 6 bands <=1; SCL water 6, 60 m shoreline erosion and cloud/shadow exclusion; minimum 25 valid pixels and 10% polygon coverage; algorithm outputs 1–100 µg/L, invalids omitted rather than clamped
mosaic: Same calendar date, platform, relative orbit, processing baseline; provider STAC timestamps <=300 seconds; one deterministic tile owner per output pixel used for SCL and all spectral bands; common 60 m UTM grid; vector union and data footprint >=95%
validation: Experimental screening only; no Karnataka field validation, accuracy scores, bloom probability or toxicity claims
